title: Local trace determinant criterion for a non-etale fibre
statement: Let $f:X \to Y$ be a finite flat morphism of schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], with $Y$ locally Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. Let $U \subset Y$ be affine, $y \in U$, and $b$ a finite basis of the section algebra $\Gamma(f^{-1}U,\mathcal O_X)$ over $\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_Y)$ induced by $f$. Define $d_b=\det(\operatorname{Tr}(m_{b_i b_j}))$. Then $y$ belongs to the zero locus of $d_b$ if and only if there is $x \in X$ with $f(x)=y$ which has no open neighbourhood $V$ such that $f|_V$ is etale [def-weil-etale-morphism]. The basis may have zero elements.

source.place: Tag 0BVH, discriminant-lemma-discriminant (Lemma 49.3.1) and its fibrewise proof

proof.text: The preimage of the affine target chart is affine because f is finite. The chosen basis makes its section algebra finite free. Tensor its multiplication matrices with the residue field at y; taking traces and determinants commutes with this operation. Thus the trace determinant vanishes at y exactly when the trace pairing of the finite fibre algebra is degenerate. Over a field a finite algebra has nondegenerate trace pairing precisely when it is a product of finite separable field extensions: nilpotents are in the radical of the trace form; after reduction the algebra is a product of fields, and the trace form on each field is nondegenerate precisely for a separable extension. Hence nonvanishing is equivalent to an etale fibre. For a flat morphism of finite presentation the fibre is etale precisely when f is etale at each of its points. The etale locus is open, so this means each x above y has a source open neighbourhood V with etale V.ι followed by f. Negating this universal statement gives the existential on the right. In rank zero the fibre is empty and the determinant is one, so both sides are false. A zero determinant is permitted, and makes both sides true at every point of the chart.

lean.statement:
theorem trace_discriminant_zeroLocus_iff_nonEtale_fibre
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian Y]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsFinite f] [Flat f] (U : Y.affineOpens) (y : Y) (hy : y ∈ U.1) :
    letI := (f.app U.1).hom.toAlgebra
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (b : Module.Basis (Fin n) Γ(Y, U.1) Γ(X, f ⁻¹ᵁ U.1)),
      y ∈ Y.zeroLocus {Algebra.discr Γ(Y, U.1) b} ↔
        ∃ x : X, f x = y ∧ ¬ (∃ V : X.Opens, x ∈ V ∧ Etale (V.ι ≫ f))
